## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ecea8116cfacc264fcd719ec75cbaec0659023b1`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md + none

Read at 2026-11-16T05:00Z. First review of this head; claim: comment 6907664060; hand-off 6907648807 and lane request 6907654348 on mailbox #33873 (the lane's at-tier reviewer was unavailable). Independence: implemented in an os-steve project thread, dispatched by domain:skills#2 (os-steve); reviewed by os-tesla, who neither dispatched nor implemented it.

### ① Derived judgments

The diff is one file, +3/−3, merge base `4bd3f240d`. Read at the head, never built or run: the diff, the card and its comments, the head's check-runs, and the files the rule cites (all outside the diff, so read and not reviewed).

- **Ask 1, widen the any-K clause to a closed list: met.** Lines 43–45 keep `K ≥ 15 ⇒ merge main first, wait for the re-run, behind excepted` word for word, then give the same action at any K for two cases: the locale-pack clause that was already there, and a shared-budget PR when main has touched the same budget's input or ledger since PRBASE. The K definition (line 41), the PRBASE definition (line 42) and the label definition (line 46) are untouched.
- **Ask 2, a cheap reading: met.** The rule names `git diff --name-only PRBASE..origin/main` against a closed pair of input:ledger entries. PRBASE is a commit on main, so the two-dot diff is exactly what main changed since the PR run's base.
- **Both budgets exist and are shared, as cited.**
  - `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: its `CEILINGS` map (line 415) holds shrink-only per-file token ceilings, most pinned at zero headroom; the catalog is walked off `skills/` and a file with no row is red. `lint.yml` runs it (lines 5438–5439). Two PRs that each fit a file's headroom overrun it together, and a ceiling re-pinned on main changes what a PR may spend, so "input or ledger" is the right pair.
  - `ui/scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs`: `PER_CHUNK_GZIP_CEILINGS` (line 2122) has four keys, `vendor-objectstack`, `i18n-locale-en`, `framework`, `ui-components`. `ci.yml` runs it as `check:eager-closure` (line 5261), on `merge_group` too. `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts:1219` routes one module into `i18n-locale-en`, `packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`; that file has no import statement; `ui/**/locales/en.ts` matches exactly that one path at the head.
- **The narrowing from "locale or strings files" to `en.ts` holds.** `i18n-locale-en` is the only locale or strings key in the ceilings. The other ten locale catalogues and the `i18n-ns-*` namespace files have chunk groups but no ceiling row, so they spend no per-chunk budget. The card's ask names locale or strings files only; the other three ceiling keys are outside it and the rule says "closed", so it does not claim them.
- **Ask 3, the replay: confirmed where I could re-read it.** Row 10: the GitHub compare `0f7389cc...8523ef9ac` is 11 commits ahead and lists `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`, with no locale file added; PR #32050's own files include the same `en.ts`. So at K 11 the old rule was silent and the new clause fires. Row 60: PR #33355 touches `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, and `git diff --name-only 82838e83 origin/main` lists `skills/` paths. Row 11 is the same queue stay as row 10. The PR body says honestly that row 60 was already inside K ≥ 15 and that neither rule binds a hand enqueue.
- **Agreement with the rest of the skill: no contradiction found.** `execution-duties.md:37` forbids chasing main in flight and points at "落地 K" for the pre-enqueue step, which is this block. `dispatch-runbook.md:226` (merge main only on conflict, main-caused red or dequeue) is the in-flight warning and predates this PR; the K rule was already its pre-enqueue counterpart. Line 27 of the same file (a base missing a merged fix means merge main, a re-run is no use) points the same way. `lanes/queue.md` does not restate K. No file under `scripts/pm` names K, PRBASE or the refresh rule (`git grep` at the head); `label-write.mjs:2682` reads this file only for the `--land` literal, which is still there.
- **The two payers.** The deleted paragraph (reader, window, contents) is held by `SKILL.md:95`, the stage-file index row, in the same words. The blank line was that paragraph's separator; with the paragraph gone it would leave two blank lines together. Neither is a rule line, and no rule text was re-wrapped to make room.

### ② Semver level

None. An internal `.claude/**` reference: no published package, no schema, no changeset owed (`skip-changeset` label). `Clause-②: no` is right, since no path is under `packages/spec/src/**`.

CI at this head: 46 check-runs, 14 success, 25 skipped, 7 in progress, none red. Still running: Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Type Check · workspace, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger. ⛔ This PASS is on the text; the seat waits for those seven to finish green before it lands, and a red one reopens the round.
CI completed before posting: 48 check-runs on this head, 23 success, 25 skipped, none failed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Governed surface: `.claude/**`, one path, Tier S. The seat lands it after this record.
- The card's fence holds: the diff changes no gate, no ceiling and no merge-queue setting.
- Line budget: the file is 112 lines at the head against a ceiling of 112 (`check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs:1307`), unchanged; no line is over 120 bytes.
- Security: none. The change teaches no security behaviour.

### ④ Design judgment

The rule holds against the code it cites and against the scenario it was accepted on (row 10: K 11, no new locale pack, `en.ts` moved on main). It errs toward refreshing, which costs one merge and one re-run and cannot let a stale PR through. As one rule it reads correctly: line 43 ends on a semicolon, line 44 opens with "或", line 45 is the list the colon announces.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- N1 (nit) — "共享预算 PR" is not defined in the file. The reader has to infer from "同本输入" that it means a PR whose own diff touches one of the two inputs; the PR body says so, the rule does not. A PR that only re-pins a ledger is left to judgment.
- N2 (nit) — The `skills/**` test is wider than the budget. The ratchet's ceilings are per file, and evals and generated references carry no row, so main moving a different skill file triggers a refresh that no shared headroom required. The card asked for this glob, and the error is on the safe side.
- N3 (nit) — The clause runs over three bullets. Elsewhere in this file a continuation is a two-space indented line under its bullet (lines 32–33 and 37–38); line 45 is a bullet with no sentence of its own.
